book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Jon I Tayak Yeisu Iye Mesaiya o Taine
Saugeine Yeisu i gopagaisi mwao wana topadavae si he-yawate si he-iwo (12), habe i seyok hiyebe yake i la i papalapu ge i papatuwohe he Galili hiyebeine-yan heidiye.
Jon Tobaptais mwage he dibula, i longe Keriso wana kaiwo wasane, bwen i patile wana topadavae si la
si tayak Yeisu si nga, “Huwo Mesaiya gane ha lapu Helak i epatile i eluwom, o age ha matemate tolomo hotiya hedi kaiwane?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Hu sehavile hu giyau Jon wana wase sahe hobak hu longe ge hu paidi:

tomatagin si palale matadiye, hebwaden hehediye ngakngakine si dodogan, toraupoga tuwadiye si dohob, tobatitui si longe lihu, tomate si suwoyuk ge togulegule Wase Dodohobine hana papalapu hobak si longe.
Gane taine i denuwo veveiwo kaiwau, Helak i muloluyan.”
Yeisu I Lihulihu Jon kaiwane

Jon wana topadavae si sesehavile, habeto Yeisu i lihulihu boda heidiye Jon kaiwane i nga, “Sauge hu la Jon heine he huyahai kevekeveine, sahe nunuwamiu hu paidi? Tab hu lok tage hu la hu paidi tolomo hotiya wana nuwotu taine i degaisi, sohode widi i gewo belen didiyewo? Tan sohode!
Hebe taine, sahe nunuwamiu hu la hu paidi? Age tolomo hotiya i sipo kaliko dodohobine? Taine, kaiwane hebwaden si sipo kaliko dodohobine si miyemiye kin he wedi guwole.
Sahe nunuwamiu hu la hu paidi? Age profet
hotiya? Bam! A liwo heimiu iye i kai lake ide profet.
Jon lihuine te profet hotiya i luluweliyan, Helak i liwo:

content.text: Lo hepapatile a patile deiyan he matam,
iye bwele hiyede i lovivine-yan kaiwam.

content: Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, hebwaden si youmate he panayawi, bwabwaligadiye Jon Tobaptais i kai lakeid. Age sega hidane i tankai suwok Helak he wana bagalogugui, iye i kai lake Jon.
I telipune saugeine Jon i papalapu hana had sauge ya, bobode ngakngakidiye si lomaleke Helak he wana bagalogugui, si hamnohon tage si ehowo.
Moses wana Logugui ge profet bwabwaligadiye si wasewase-yan Helak wana bagalogugui wana luwom hana had Jon.
Ge Jon iye Ilaija gane profet hotiya i nga i eluwom. Akum hu goru sohode ti ya.
Hebe batimiu i gan, lo lihulihu ya hu longe.
Bobode sai hebwaden yan ya, sahe heine a papatini-yanid? Sidiye sohode bubuyese si tutuwodau he bagamwaket, bwen papaine si gon hene-bwaidiye heidiye si nga:

content.text: Ha wi haduwe hana igo kaiwamiu, bwen taine hu desali.
Ha wokan nuwongak wokine, bwen taine hu detan.

content: Sai hebwaden yan ya wedi page sohode te bubuyese yake wedi page, si papariyere. Kaiwane Jon i luwom ge i palahasik buwota, ge taine i demun waen, iyete bobode si nga, ‘Yayaluwo bikbikine i solavi heine.’

Agegene nau Tolomo Natune a luwom, a han ge a mun, iyete bobode si nga, ‘Tolomo ga ya iye tosoni ge tomunmun, iye takis hana tohowo ge togegi wedi pebwange.’ Agegene sibe gane i hudi Helak heine, ta paidi muiine ge ta hawa tolosuwok-an.”
Hiyebe Hebwaden Taine Si Deseyok wedi Page Ngakngakine
Habe Yeisu i hawa ngakngak-anid hiyebe-yan hebwaden pamali yauyawate i ginawiid i hoyowate he gamwadiye, kaiwane taine si deseyok wedi page ngakngakine.

I nga, “Eeu! Korasin, humiu benan hu ngak! Eeu! Betsaida, humiu benan hu ngak! Akum pamali yauyawate gane a ginawiid heimiu veto gen a ginawi Taya ge Saidon heidiye, sidiye toyauneik kaliko gane si ginawi he man pupululune si sipo ge tuwadiye si yawi he pwaihau, iloke si payoumateid te hobak si seyok wedi gegi.
A liwo heimiu, he hasehase hana yan, Taya ge Saidon hedi pepelase i puyowo, age humiu hemi pepelase bwele i puyowo suwok.

“Mwatan humiu Kapeniyam! Age nuwamiu hidamiu hu hotei senge nate? Agegene bwele si bili dongemiu hu sedau hel. Akum pamali yauyawate gane a ginawiid heimiu veto gen a ginawi Sodom, sidiye si seyok wedi page ngakngakine habe taine pepelase si depaidi, iloke hiyebe Sodom habe mwage i miyemiye hana had yan ya.
A liwo heimiu, he hasehase hana yan, Sodom hedi pepelase i puyowo, age humiu hemi pepelase bwele i puyowo suwok.”
Hu Luwom heyau Iloke A Pamanaomiu

He saugeine yake Yeisu i liwo i nga, “A tobaliwo Tamau, bulubulu ge panayawi wedi Guyau, kaiwane u ho sumwan lam bagalogugui hana lapu tosibe ge tolapu heidiye ge hobak u payoumate hebwaden sohode bubuyese heidiye.
Bam, Tamau, kaiwane huwo lam nuwotu sohode.

“Tamau hobak i giyau heyau lapu bwabwaligane iloke a payoumate bobode heidiye. Taine hotiya i delapuyau, Tamau ege, ge taine hotiya i delapu Tamau, iyege te nau Natune ge hebwaden habe a haseid a payoumate Tamau heidiye.
“Hu luwom heyau bwabwaligamiu, humiu hebwaden puyowo hu hiyewo ge tuwamiu si saole, iloke a pamanaomiu.
Hiyewo gane a giyau gen hu howo ge hu lapu heyau, kaiwane a hodonge totou ge lo page i malum, iloke bwele manao hu paidi.
Kaiwane hiyewo gane a giyau i meyan ge duwohe gane a giyau taine i depuyowo.”

footnotes.text: Profet-yan sidiye Helak halingane hana towase.
